description: Every field a call to assets may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

background.description: the icon's background as hex: one colour (solid) or two or three (a gradient, top to bottom); picked from the name when left out

backing.description: what the medallion is set in: a hex colour for its stone, or none for nothing (the dish is then the image's edge, clear outside it); a light stone grey when left out

contrast.description: whether every colour set also gets high-contrast colours; false when left out

data.description: one data set a line: `name: path/to/file` in the project

font.description: the font family or face for the monogram and wordmark: a bundled macOS font such as Avenir Next (the default), Futura, Georgia, Didot or Menlo; never SF Pro

foreground.description: the mark's colour on the icon as hex; white or ink, by contrast, when left out; a colour that would show under 3:1 on the background is set aside for white or ink

image.description: the picture when mark is image, relative to the project: PNG, JPEG, PDF or SVG; a square opaque PNG is used as the whole icon

into.description: the asset catalog, relative to the project; Shared/Assets.xcassets when left out

letters.description: the monogram's one to three letters; the name's initials when left out

mark.description: what the mark is: monogram (letters, the default), shape (a geometric glyph), image (a picture in the project) or medallion (a struck-metal medallion set in stone, drawn as PNGs); a shape's own name (spark, knot, …) draws that shape

metal.description: the medallion's metal: silver (the default), bronze, gold, or a hex colour for its middle tone

motif.description: the medallion's engraved band: swirls (raised S-curls, the default) or plain

name.description: the app's name: the monogram's initials and the wordmark; the Xcode project's name when left out

palette.description: one colour set a line, `name: #light/#dark` (one hex for both); `accent:` also sets AccentColor, `LaunchBackground:` colours the launch screen

platforms.description: the platforms the icon is drawn for: ios, macos, watchos, visionos; ios and macos when left out

seed.description: a whole number, 0 or more, for the medallion's grain (its brushing and its stone): the same seed draws the same pixels; 0 when left out

sets.description: what to make: icon, accent, colors, logos, launch, placeholders, empty, symbols, data; all but symbols and data when left out

shape.description: the glyph when mark is shape: ring, knot, wave, spark, stack, leaf, bubble or grid

symbols.description: one custom symbol a line: `name: SVG path data in a 0…100 box`, stroked at every weight; a name ending .fill is filled

view.description: the mark as a SwiftUI view, by its type's name (SeerMark): one Swift file whose view draws Image("LogoMark") resizable and scaled to fit, filling whatever frame it is given

viewInto.description: the folder for the view's file, relative to the project; Shared/Design when left out

wordmark.description: the text of the wordmark and lockup; the name when left out
